snippet.title: Tanveer Evan - Royaa Main (रोया मैं) | Official Music Video
snippet.description:
Royaa Main (रोया मैं | رویا میں) — a story of love that stayed, even when the person didn’t.

Some people leave, but their memories never really do. They remain in the quiet nights, familiar places, unfinished conversations, and dreams you wish you could return to.

“Khoya main, khoya main, khoya
Tere pyaar mein khoya
Royaa main, royaa main, royaa
Tere pyaar mein royaa…”

Royaa Main captures the feeling of losing yourself in someone falling so deeply in love that even after they’re gone, a part of you is still waiting for them.

A song for everyone who has ever loved, lost, and still remembered. ❤️‍🩹


Lyrics :

Tere pyaar mein khoya
Royaa main, royaa main, royaa
Tere pyaar mein royaa..

Dil ye mera tanha sa rehta

chand muskurati rahe
tere hi khaab liye..
